summary: -i controls a timed loop that calls the OpenMP CSR SpMV once per iteration. Each call processes the full row domain, and each row's complete half-open nonzero interval is accumulated and written; compiled host control retains the iteration loop and the worker retains row/nonzero back edges.

source_evidence.claim: The command-line -i value sets iterations and the timed loop calls spmvCpu once per iteration.
spmvCpu uses rowDelimiters[dim] for workload sizing, parallelizes the complete [0,dim) row domain, traverses every row's [rowStart,rowEnd) nonzero interval, and writes each output row.

compiled_evidence.claim: Inside the timed interval, the native host control repeatedly invokes the OpenMP SpMV worker and compares its loop counter against the parsed iteration count before the end-time read.

primary_quality_check.method: Primary directly inspected all four pilot programs: parsed iteration counts, timed host repetition loops, complete CSR row/nonzero traversals and output stores. Inspected emitted CPU/OpenMP repetition and row/nonzero backedges; CUDA and hybrid host dispatch backedges, device CSR loads, DFMA loops/backedges and stores. Checked contiguous MPI/rank/GPU row partitions and rebased CSR slices. Repeated overwrites of A*x match the unchanged reference. No execution or recompilation.
